name: openHAB
description: Open home automation platform for devices of every brand

paths.name: Conf
paths.description: Your text configuration: things, items, rules, sitemaps and services.

paths.name: Userdata
paths.description: openHAB's database, settings made in the web app, users, logs and persistence. Back it up.

paths.name: Addons
paths.description: Add-on files you install by hand (.jar or .kar).

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: openHAB web app and REST API, published on host as 6855

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: USER_ID
variables.description: The user openHAB runs as. It is filled in by MOS.

variables.name: GROUP_ID
variables.description: The group openHAB runs as. It is filled in by MOS.

variables.name: CRYPTO_POLICY
variables.description: Leave as unlimited for full encryption support.
